F.data_reference: definitional; Faraday constant, SN_simple's rounding of the CODATA 2018 exact value 96485.33212 C/mol

T.data_reference: davis2021transcriptomic; Methods (Ch. 2): "All recordings were performed at room temperature" (value not stated; 22 degC assumed); p. 215: neurons died above 30 degC

Delta_V_mid_w.data_reference: definitional; drug-induced shift of the M-channel activation midpoint (0 = control; e.g. retigabine studies)

E_K.data_reference: definitional; Nernst potential RT/F ln(Ko/Ki) at Ko 4.5, Ki 200 mM, 295.15 K (the soma defaults; used when unconnected)

V.data_reference: definitional; clamp value when unconnected: the SN resting potential (-70 mV, cf. davis2020downregulation)

V_den_w.data_reference: martin2023modelling; Methods (p. 16): w_inf k = 10 mV (= value)

V_mid_w.data_reference: martin2023modelling; Methods (p. 16): w_inf V1/2 = -35 mV (= value; from Zhou et al.)

V_rest_approx.data_reference: davis2020downregulation; resting membrane potential of rat stellate neurons: Wistar -72.6 +- 1.0 mV (Fig. 4C), SHR -70.3 +- 1.4 mV (Fig. 5D); -70 mV approximates it (the CA token cites davis2021transcriptomic, whose current-clamp traces the value was read from)

A_mem.data_reference: definitional; the soma membrane area 3000 um^2 (used when unconnected; in a soma it comes from the membrane through the membrane_area port)

rho_M.data_reference: davis2020downregulation; Calibrated (libcuflynx) to parameterisations/davis2020_wistar/davis2020_wistar_obs_data.json: davis2020downregulation Fig. 3C Wistar XE-991-sensitive I_M -4.03 pA/pF x Cm 30 pF (assumed), the deactivation relaxation in a 1 s step from -25 to -55 mV (current after the ohmic jump minus that near the end of the step; davis2021transcriptomic p. 172-173); E_K -96.5 mV (Ki 200 mM, 22 degC); re-derived on review 2026-10-05 (was 0.00263 uS with E_K -93.7, from the -25/-55 mV steady-state difference). g_M = A rho gamma_M = 0.005479 uS at A 3000 um^2, gamma_M 9 pS; it depends on tau_w (with the present tau_w the relaxation is 87 % complete at 1 s)

gamma_M.data_reference: selyanko2001properties; KCNQ2/KCNQ3 (M-type) single-channel conductance 9.0 +- 0.3 pS (Abstract, point 2); native rat SCG M-channels show ~7, 12 and 19 pS levels (Selyanko & Brown 1993)

tau_w_min.data_reference: owner's floor (CA 72f29290, CA_user b8488ae, 2025-03-31); not in martin2023modelling (no offset); the CA token cites gupta2016computational, an SK-channel bladder model, **which is unlikely to be the source** (not verified)

tau_w_num.data_reference: martin2023modelling; Methods (p. 16): tau_w = 400/(3.3 exp((V+35)/10) + exp(-(V+35)/20)) ms (from Zhou et al.); **numerator modified here to 1200 ms (3x the source)** (owner calibration: 200 -> 800 -> 1200, CA_user ad0ce77/a7a4a58, 2024) **Kept on review (2026-10-05) although the one davis2020downregulation Fig. 3C trace relaxes with tau ~74 ms at -55 mV (instance davis2020_wistar_kinetics refits a flat ~105 ms): the slow tau_w carries the spike-frequency adaptation of the SN_full calibration (sympathetic_neuron SN_full/model_changes/im_adaptation_investigation.html)**

Q10_M.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; conventional gating Q10 (no effect while T_ref = T)

T_ref_M.data_reference: definitional; equal to the model temperature, so kinetics are unscaled; to be set to the source's recording temperature on review
